cues.caption: Offer Check tells you if a job offer really beats what you have now. Here's how to fill it in.
cues.say: Offer Check tells you if a job offer really beats what you have now. Here's how to fill it in.

cues.caption: Step one: your current package, top to bottom.
cues.say: Step one: your current package, top to bottom.

cues.caption: Base salary, employer pension, and your typical bonus.
cues.say: Base salary, employer pension, and your typical bonus.

cues.caption: How much of that bonus you can rely on.
cues.say: How much of that bonus you can rely on.

cues.caption: Then allowances, medical, holiday, and your working week.
cues.say: Then allowances, medical, holiday, and your working week.

cues.caption: Your commute: cost and hours.
cues.say: Your commute: cost, and hours.

cues.caption: Open the pension section to add what you pay in, any matching, and whether it's salary sacrifice.
cues.say: Open the pension section to add what you pay in, any matching, and whether it's salary sacrifice.

cues.caption: Step two: ask the recruiter these questions, and note the answers.
cues.say: Step two: ask the recruiter these questions, and note the answers.

cues.caption: There are 18, from the salary band to probation, parental leave and sign-on bonuses.
cues.say: There are eighteen, from the salary band to probation, parental leave, and sign-on bonuses.

cues.caption: Get their salary band before you name a number.
cues.say: Get their salary band before you name a number.

cues.caption: Step three: fill in the offer, in the same order. £82,000 base, and a 3% pension.
cues.say: Step three: fill in the offer, in the same order. Eighty-two thousand pounds base, and a three percent pension.

cues.caption: They'll match another 3% if you pay in. But it isn't salary sacrifice.
cues.say: They'll match another three percent if you pay in. But it isn't salary sacrifice.

cues.caption: If the bonus is only a target, count half of it.
cues.say: If the bonus is only a target, count half of it.

cues.caption: A sign-on bonus goes under one-off payments. It counts in year one, not in the verdict.
cues.say: A sign-on bonus goes under one-off payments. It counts in year one, not in the verdict.

cues.caption: Step four: set your decision lines. 10% and 20% are good defaults. Raise them for riskier roles.
cues.say: Step four: set your decision lines. Ten and twenty percent are good defaults. Raise them for riskier roles.

cues.caption: Then add where you pay tax, and your student loan plan.
cues.say: Then add where you pay tax, and your student loan plan.

cues.caption: The verdict: break-even. After tax, the offer is only 5% better.
cues.say: The verdict: break-even. After tax, the offer is only five percent better.

cues.caption: Before tax, it looked like 9%. You'd lose salary sacrifice and four points of pension, and both are worth more than they seem.
cues.say: Before tax, it looked like nine percent. You'd lose salary sacrifice, and four points of pension, and both are worth more than they seem.

cues.caption: Your take-home still rises by £408 a month, and your hourly rate, counting the commute, goes from £28 to £31.
cues.say: Your take-home still rises by four hundred and eight pounds a month, and your hourly rate, counting the commute, goes from twenty-eight pounds to thirty-one.

cues.caption: To reach Consider, ask for a base of about £86,900.
cues.say: To reach Consider, ask for a base of about eighty-six thousand, nine hundred pounds.

cues.caption: Copy summary keeps your numbers and the recruiter's answers together.
cues.say: Copy summary keeps your numbers and the recruiter's answers together.

cues.caption: Copy link opens your comparison on another device, without your notes.
cues.say: Copy link opens your comparison on another device, without your notes.

cues.caption: Offer Check. Know your numbers before you say yes.
cues.say: Offer Check. Know your numbers before you say yes.
